# Vendored Sonora crates

`music`, `storage` and `widevine` are vendored from [Sonora](https://github.com/sonorahq/sonora),
licensed GPL-3.0-or-later (see [COPYING](COPYING)).

Cauce's modifications: a configurable sign-in return page, free Spotify accounts, Tidal previews,
Deezer encodings and stream capabilities used by the mobile app, and Cauce's own identity
(cache and data folders, user agents, scrobbling client and Spotify Connect device names).
Copyright and licence notices are unchanged.
